howto.name: Upload an image
howto.text: Drop a JPG, PNG, WebP, or BMP file with sensitive content you want to obscure.

howto.name: Choose effect + strength
howto.text: Pick Pixelate (mosaic, still readable as 'something censored') or Blur (Gaussian, smoother). Strength slider 1-100.

howto.name: Download the result
howto.text: The processed image downloads immediately. The original is deleted from the server seconds later.

faq.q: Pixelate vs blur — which should I use?
faq.a: Pixelate is reversible (depixelization attacks can sometimes recover content) but reads clearly as 'censored'. Blur is harder to reverse but can look like a normal photo defect. For true privacy on serious content, use both: blur first then pixelate.

faq.q: Can I select a specific region?
faq.a: This tool applies the effect to the whole image. For region-selective censoring, upload to an image editor first (e.g. our Edit PDF for documents) and white-out or rectangle over the area.
No — your image is processed in an isolated Docker container and deleted the moment the response is returned.
